_note: Which owner's manual belongs to which car. A manual is used ONLY when the car's year, make, model, trim AND engine (which includes the drivetrain, e.g. '3.8L V6 GDi · FWD') all match this entry, ignoring capitals and extra spaces. Every field is required: an entry missing any of them is never used. A car with no exact match gets no AI check, so a manual for another car is never sent. To add a car: put its manual (PDF or .txt) in this folder and add an entry, spelling make/model/trim/engine exactly as the car form on screen 02 lists them.
